summary: colinlyguo 把 EIP-7851 简化为基于 EIP-7702 的极简改动，去掉 7 天宽限期，用保留的 DEACTIVATE_ADDRESS 停用委托账户的 ECDSA 权限，并合并。EIP-8141 支持任意 frame 的原子批处理并合并，nerolation 提交交易过期 frame。EIP-8130 调整 gas 与验证器校验。EIP-8037 按 150M gas limit 和每年 120 GiB 状态增长重新校准参数。

items.topic: EOA 密钥停用：EIP-7851 与 EIP-8151
items.title: EIP-7851：简化 ECDSA 权限停用
items.note: （colinlyguo）提交并合并。根据论坛和核心开发者讨论，去掉 7 天宽限期，改为基于 EIP-7702 的极简协议改动：在现有 7702 授权流程中使用保留的 `DEACTIVATE_ADDRESS`，把有效委托从 `0xef0100 || delegate_address` 变为 `0xef0101 || delegate_address`。
items.note_en: (colinlyguo), submitted and merged. Based on forum and core dev feedback, it removes the 7-day grace period and becomes a minimal EIP-7702 based protocol change: a reserved `DEACTIVATE_ADDRESS` in the existing 7702 authorization flow changes an active delegation from `0xef0100 || delegate_address` to `0xef0101 || delegate_address`.

items.title: EIP-8130：更新 gas 与验证器校验
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交并合并：发送方认证和内在成本纳入签名的 `gas_limit`，限制付款方承担的风险；付款方认证单独计量 `payer_auth_cost`，付款方选择的验证器不会减少可用于调用的 gas。EIP-8130：加入 metadata sink 提交，仅供讨论。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: update gas and verifier validation
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted and merged: sender authentication and intrinsic costs move under the signed `gas_limit`, bounding payer exposure; payer authentication is metered separately as `payer_auth_cost`, so the payer's verifier choice cannot reduce gas available to calls. EIP-8130: add metadata sink, submitted for discussion only.

items.title: EIP-8130：加入 metadata sink
items.note: EIP-8130：更新 gas 与验证器校验（chunter-cb）提交并合并：发送方认证和内在成本纳入签名的 `gas_limit`，限制付款方承担的风险；付款方认证单独计量 `payer_auth_cost`，付款方选择的验证器不会减少可用于调用的 gas。EIP-8130：加入 metadata sink 提交，仅供讨论。
items.note_en: EIP-8130: update gas and verifier validation (chunter-cb), submitted and merged: sender authentication and intrinsic costs move under the signed `gas_limit`, bounding payer exposure; payer authentication is metered separately as `payer_auth_cost`, so the payer's verifier choice cannot reduce gas available to calls. EIP-8130: add metadata sink, submitted for discussion only.

items.topic: 交易与 gas：EIP-8037 和 EIP-8038
items.title: EIP-8037：更新参数与 rationale
items.note: （misilva73）合并：按 150M 参考区块 gas limit 与每年 120 GiB 状态增长目标重新校准，`CPSB` 从 1174 提高到 1530；`STATE_BYTES_PER_STORAGE_SET` 从 32 改为 64，`STATE_BYTES_PER_NEW_ACCOUNT` 从 112 改为 120，计入叶子的 key。
items.note_en: (misilva73), merged: recalibrated to a 150M reference block gas limit and a 120 GiB per year state growth target, raising `CPSB` from 1174 to 1530; `STATE_BYTES_PER_STORAGE_SET` goes from 32 to 64 and `STATE_BYTES_PER_NEW_ACCOUNT` from 112 to 120 to include the leaf key.

keywords_en: EIP-7851 becomes a minimal EIP-7702 based key deactivation
EIP-8141 atomic batching with any frames
summary_en: colinlyguo simplified EIP-7851 into a minimal EIP-7702 based change, removing the 7-day grace period and using a reserved DEACTIVATE_ADDRESS to deactivate the ECDSA authority of delegated accounts, and it was merged. EIP-8141 gained atomic batching with any frames, merged, and nerolation submitted a transaction expiry frame. EIP-8130 updated gas and verifier validation. EIP-8037 recalibrated its parameters to a 150M gas limit and 120 GiB per year of state growth.
